sloka: आग्नेयमस्त्रं तस्मै स मुमोच धनदस्तदा ।राक्षसेन्द्रो वारुणेन तदस्त्रं प्रत्यवारयत् ।। ७.१५.३१ ॥
transliteration: āgneyamastraṁ tasmai sa mumoca dhanadastadā ।rākṣasendro vāruṇena tadastraṁ pratyavārayat ।। 7.15.31 ॥

translations.english: Then Dhanada released the fiery weapon at him, but the lord of Rakshasas countered that weapon with the Varuna weapon.
